retrievalProfile.description: A layered collage style featuring photographic cutouts with thick borders set against oversized floral backgrounds and organic script typography.

recipe.visualDefinition: A dense, layered composition where multiple photographic portraits are 'cut out' with visible thick, light-colored outlines and arranged over a background of large, stylized roses in varying colors. The typography is integrated into the center of the floral pattern using a fluid, monoline script.
coreVisualRelationships: Subject cutouts overlapping large floral elements
Thick cream-colored borders around photographic subjects
Centralized script typography following the curve of the background rose
High-contrast mix of natural skin tones and vibrant floral hues
coreInvariants: Thick, hand-cut style outlines on all photographic elements
Oversized rose motifs as the primary background texture
Monolinear cursive script with decorative loops

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Three portraits are distributed around the edges (top right, left, bottom center), framing the central text.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The large pink rose in the center acts as the primary canvas for the text.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: The eye moves in a circular motion from the top-right portrait, down to the bottom, and up to the left, finally resting on the central text.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Minimal; the composition is packed with overlapping textures and shapes.

colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Teal and cobalt blue (secondary floral elements)
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High saturation in the flowers contrasts with the naturalistic, slightly warm-toned skin of the portraits.

letterConstructionRules: Exaggerated loops on ascenders and descenders
Fluid, connected script with a slight upward tilt
characterSpecificRedesigns: Capital 'C' with a large, inward-curling top loop
Lowercase 'g' and 'y' with wide, rounded descender loops
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Single decorative script used for all text elements to maintain a personal, 'scrapbook' feel.

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the hand-drawn, informal feel of the original lettering.
Captures the decorative loops and personal touch.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Create a collage of three fashion portraits of women with 90s hairstyles, each with a thick cream-colored border. Arrange them around a central large pink rose, with blue and green roses in the corners.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Apply a dark monoline cursive script in the center of the pink rose, using staggered line breaks.

verificationChecks: Are the portrait outlines thick and consistent?
Is the script monoline without thick/thin variation?
Do the roses overlap the portraits in some areas?

mustRedesign: Specific facial features of the subjects
Exact brand logos or specific text strings

mustAchieve: Vibrant but slightly muted vintage color palette

postGenerationChecks: Ensure the text is centered on the largest floral element.
Check that the cream borders look like paper cutouts.
Verify the script has decorative loops on 'g', 'l', and 'h'.
Confirm the color palette includes pink, blue, and teal.
recipe.reuseFormula: Collage of [Subject Type] with [Border Color] outlines + [Flower Type] background + [Script Style] central text.
